description: Use this when the user wants to know which items 2 or 3 lists share and which are unique, without a diagram, for example "which names are on both lists" or "compare these three guest lists". Takes 2 or 3 named lists (up to 500 items each, 80 characters per item) and a case option. Returns each region (only A, only B, A and B, ...) with its count and items, the overlap percentage for each pair, and a CSV with each item's region. Does not read files, does not fuzzy-match spellings, and does not draw a diagram.

case_sensitive.description: false (default): "Apple" and "apple" are the same item. true: case matters.

sets.description: 2 or 3 named lists to compare. Each set: {"name":"Team A","items":["Ann","Bo","Cy"]}. Names up to 40 characters; up to 500 items per set, each up to 80 characters.

name: compare_lists
title: Compare lists
